# GTMObserver
> The Edge-Native Google Tag Manager Automation & Autonomous GA4 Telemetry Platform.

GTMObserver (https://gtmobserver.com) is an enterprise analytics automation SaaS built natively on Cloudflare Workers edge architecture. It solves two critical challenges for digital analytics agencies, e-commerce brands, and marketing teams:
1. **Automated Google Tag Manager (GTM) Deployment**: 1-click deployment of production-grade tracking architectures directly into Google Tag Manager containers via the official Google Tag Manager API. Eliminates manual tag creation, custom JavaScript debugging, and human errors.
2. **Autonomous GA4 Telemetry Observer & Alerts**: 24/7 background edge monitoring that continuously evaluates Google Analytics 4 properties. Detects tracking crashes, conversion dropoffs, key event anomalies, and traffic fluctuations against historical baselines, dispatching real-time email alerts to teams and clients before revenue is lost.

## Core Capabilities
- **Automated GTM Recipe Library**:
  - Basic Outbound Clicks (phone `tel:`, email `mailto:`, generic outbound links).
  - Social Engagement (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok outbound clicks).
  - WordPress Form Ecosystem (Elementor Forms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, HubSpot).
  - Hotel & Hospitality Booking Engines (Synxis / SBE, StayNTouch, Revinate, Zmail).
  - E-Commerce Data Layers (WooCommerce standard GA4 events: `view_item`, `add_to_cart`, `purchase`).
  - Scroll Depth (25%, 50%, 75%, 90% threshold triggers).
  - Video Tracking (HTML5, YouTube, Vimeo play/pause/complete).
- **GA4 Real-Time Anomaly Detection**:
  - Evaluates live metrics (`sessions`, `keyEvents`/conversions, `purchaseRevenue`, `screenPageViews`).
  - Dimensional traffic segmentation (All Traffic, Organic Search, Paid Search, Social, Referral, Email).
  - Flexible comparison periods (Yesterday vs 2 Days Ago, Yesterday vs Last Week, Last 7 vs Previous 7, Last 28 vs Previous 28, Last 30 vs Previous 30, Yearly).
  - Multi-condition compound evaluation (Match ALL or Match ANY rules).
  - Automated Cron execution runs every hour at the Cloudflare edge.
- **Enterprise Multi-Recipient Dispatch**:
  - Real-time alert emails with DKIM/SPF authenticated deliverability via Resend (`alerts@gtmobserver.com`).
  - Dual history logging (Automated issue incidents vs Manual test reports).
  - Client-ready telemetry breakdowns with baseline comparisons and percentage changes.

## Pricing Tiers
- **Free Tier ($0/month)**:
  - 1 Active GA4 Monitor.
  - Daily background anomaly checks.
  - Single alert recipient.
  - Unlimited manual test reports.
- **Pro Tier ($149/month)**:
  - Up to 10 Active GA4 Monitors.
  - Hourly background edge checks.
  - Multi-recipient team & client email dispatch.
  - Compound rules (AND / OR logic).
  - Complete Dual History audit logs.
- **Custom / Agency Tier ($149+/month)**:
  - 10 to 100+ Custom property monitors.
  - Volume container discounts (10% off for 15+ containers).
  - Dedicated priority support and custom SLAs.
